steps.caption: New Zion: a city of stone and songs… until the mist fell.
With the mist came the shadows: lies, fears, envy. The people stopped singing.
In the ruins of a house, a young man finds an open Bible.
lines: "Be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power. Put on the full armor of God…" (Ephesians 6:10-11)
Who am I going to fight? I see no one.
"For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but… against the powers of this world’s darkness…" (Ephesians 6:12)
I was chained and alone too. Put on the armor, son. You do not walk alone.
Start with the Word: it is your sword. Shoot light wherever there is a lie.
Well done. The little lies run from the truth.
There were so many. And they spoke with my own voice.
That is how lies talk. That is why you need the Word close.
"Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free." (John 8:32)

steps.caption: The Great Eye of Envy falls. A belt shines among its remains.
lines: The belt of truth. Fasten it tight.
And what good is it? No one up there sees you.
The same as always. Since the garden it asks the same thing.
Do not answer it with your ideas. Answer with what God said.

steps.caption: Goliath falls. A breastplate lies at its feet.
lines: It was huge. I thought I could not do it.
I sank when I looked at the waves instead of looking at Him.
Take the breastplate of righteousness. And this sword of fire: it cuts the shadows up close.
"For the word of God is living and active. Sharper than any double-edged sword…" (Hebrews 4:12)
You are tired. I can give you whatever you ask, no effort.
Just bow for a moment. No one will know.
"…Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light." (2 Corinthians 11:14)
"…God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape…" (1 Corinthians 10:13)
There was a way out. There always was.
Blessed is the one who endures temptation. You will receive the crown of life.

steps.caption: From the tower, the fallen walls of the city can be seen.
lines: Many people stopped rebuilding. They grew tired.

steps.caption: A shield appears among the rubble.
lines: It is the shield of faith. It puts out the fiery darts.
"Take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one." (Ephesians 6:16)
Something worse is below. It smells of rotten roots.
That is bitterness. It grows where we do not forgive.
Little child, bitterness dries up where there is forgiveness.
"Be kind and tenderhearted to one another, forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you." (Ephesians 4:32)
I forgive those who hurt me. It is hard, but I do it.
Then you are already freer than they are.

steps.caption: Behemoth falls. Its crown rolls across the floor.
lines: "Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall." (Proverbs 16:18)
Humble yourselves under the mighty hand of God. He lifts you up in due time.
Now the helmet of salvation. Guard your mind: up there the storm screams.

steps.caption: The islands float in the storm. The light is behind the clouds.
Two giant shadows wait there: Doubt… and Discouragement.

lines: What if God does not hear you?
You are weak. You will not make it.
"My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness." (2 Corinthians 12:9)

steps.caption: Doubt and Discouragement dissolve in the rain.
lines: "And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick. The Lord will raise him up." (James 5:15)
I doubted too, in the middle of the sea. And He took my hand.
"You of little faith, why did you doubt?" (Matthew 14:31)
I get up. One more to go.

steps.caption: Below, in the abyss, the ancient serpent stirs.

lines: I was here before your city. Before you.
"In that day the LORD will take His sharp, great, and mighty sword, and bring judgment on Leviathan…" (Isaiah 27:1)
Put on the whole armor. And stand firm.

steps.caption: Leviathan sinks into the abyss.
lines: No, son. He had already defeated it. You stood firm.
"And having disarmed the powers and authorities, He made a public spectacle of them, triumphing over them by the cross." (Colossians 2:15)

steps.caption: The clouds open. The light falls on New Zion.
The mist lifts. The people come out into the streets.
lines: They are rebuilding the walls. And they are singing again.
There is still road ahead, isn't there?
"In the world you will have tribulation. But take courage; I have overcome the world!" (John 16:33)

steps.caption: END OF THE FIRST JOURNEY
lines: "…let us run with endurance the race set out for us. Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith…" (Hebrews 12:1-2)

c01_l1_radio: Those red creatures are little lies. Your light undoes them.
The green eyes are envies: they do not move, but they watch.
Find the key and tear down the idols.
c01_l3_radio: The mountains at night are frightening. But you are not alone.
"Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for You are with me." (Psalm 23:4)
c01_l4_radio: The mountain gate is shut. The key fell outside, on the slope.
And something big roars up ahead.
c01_l5_radio: These are the walls the people let fall.
Why raise up what will only fall again?
Do not listen to it. Nehemiah did not listen either.
"…for the people had a mind to work." (Nehemiah 4:6)
c01_l6_radio: Hounds of fear sleep around the tower. Slip past without waking them if you can.
"There is no fear in love, but perfect love drives out fear." (1 John 4:18)
c01_l8_radio: Those roots are bitterness. Cut them all.
"…that no root of bitterness springs up to cause trouble…" (Hebrews 12:15)
c01_l9_intro: Three seals guard the shadow's fortress. They are scattered across the islands.
c01_l9_zonas: Careful: some wind currents lift you on their own. Let them carry you.
c01_l9_behemoth: That is a little behemoth: pride, small. Shield in front; hit it from behind.
c01_l9_radio: Do you really think you will make it?
Yes. But I am not held up by my own hands.
"Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you…" (Isaiah 41:10)
c01_l10_intro: The three seals answer. The abyss opens.
This is the last stretch. Run the race to the end.
c01_l10_hangar: Stop. Many shadows sleep there. They wake if you make noise.
c01_l10_veyr: "If God is for us, who can be against us?" (Romans 8:31)
c01_l10_alas: Is that all? I have swallowed whole kingdoms.
c01_l10_nucleo: Those chains hold it up! Break them.
